title: What Happens When Lightning Hits Sand
hook: You think lightning vanishes the instant it hits the earth.
script: You think lightning vanishes the instant it hits the earth. What if you could reach into the sand and pull out its actual shape? When electricity strikes, heat five times hotter than the sun melts quartz sand instantly. Trapped moisture vaporizes into steam, blasting open a hollow tube of natural glass. Geologists call this subterranean frozen scar a fulgurite. Some of these glass roots branch meters into the soil, recording one microsecond. Long after the thunder fades, the lightning is still down there.
